/volunteer.title: Seasonal Volunteers, Open Call
/volunteer.description: Join {{platformName}} as a seasonal volunteer. Live on the land, learn by doing and contribute to a regenerative community.

content.title: Volunteer seasons at {{platformName}}
content.body:
We invite volunteers to join us through our seasons at {{platformName}}, supporting every area of the project, from the garden and the kitchen to hospitality and building.

We are looking for enthusiastic people who want to live, learn and contribute to a growing community based on respect for the land and each other. As a volunteer you will take part in the activities, events and workshops happening throughout the season.

items.title: Spring season
items.text: February to end of June

items.title: Fall season
items.text: September to end of November

items.title: Volunteering is rooted in genuine contribution
items.text: {{platformName}} is a living, working regenerative project, and the energy and care people bring here is what keeps it alive. We welcome volunteers who are excited to roll up their sleeves and actively participate in the work of regeneration, whether that is in the garden, the kitchen, or hospitality. This is not a place to escape or to stay cheaply. It is a place to show up fully for the vision of a bigger, brighter future.

items.title: Minimum stay
items.text: This allows enough time to truly settle in, find your rhythm with the community, and make a meaningful contribution to the work here. Shorter stays do not give enough space for the kind of depth and trust that makes the experience worthwhile, for you, for us, and for the land.

items.title: Arrivals are on Tuesday mornings
items.text: New volunteers always arrive on Tuesday morning for an onboarding session, followed by a landing circle. Please plan your travel around this.

items.title: Local wage earners
items.text: We want to make it possible for more people from this region to stay with us. If you live locally on a genuinely low income, write to us before you apply and we will find an arrangement that works.

items.title: Working hours are 9am to 1pm, daily
items.text: We keep to this schedule. The day starts with a playful 9am stand-up where we decide on the tasks together. These hours are not flexible, because they hold the group flow in the mornings. If you have morning meetings or commitments, this may not be the right opportunity for you right now.

items.title: Coming with children
items.text: If you are coming with children, please ask the space host about whether this can be organised in parallel with volunteering.

items.title: From volunteer to resident
items.text: Full work exchanges, which we call residencies, are for specific skilled roles and require a one to three month full-time commitment. Anyone hoping to become a resident at {{platformName}} must first complete a volunteer stay, so we can get to know each other.

items.title: Rituals and community life
items.text: Our volunteer program offers insight into the weekly rituals of our community, with sharing spaces for deep listening, community care, and co-created workshops and skill swaps.

content.title: Daily contribution
content.description: A daily contribution helps keep everything running. VAT included. In return for your work hours you receive a dorm bed, a camping spot or a van parking spot, and you will be fed really well.

content.title: Skills and qualifications that can support us

items.title: Gardening
items.text: Syntropic beds, nursery, care

items.title: Hospitality
items.text: Guest care, spaces, events

items.title: Kitchen and cooking
items.text: Three meals a day, together

items.title: Building projects
items.text: Natural build, carpentry

items.title: Land care
items.text: Water systems, trees, maintenance

items.title: Marketing and content
items.text: Social media, photo, video

/projects.title: Builders Residency Open Call
/projects.description: Join the build at {{platformName}}. Take on a self-build project, earn token rewards, and live with the crew on the land.

content.title: Builders Residency Open Call
content.body: Pick a project, bring your hands, and help build {{platformName}}.

content.title: We are starting to build
content.body:
{{platformName}} is building. Alongside the work done by professional contractors, we self-build the projects that shape the village.

Every project below is a real piece of that build, with its own scope, budget and reward. Find one that matches your skills and apply to it directly.

items.title: Requirements
items.text: 6 hours per day, 1 month minimum. Free accommodation and food — glamping tents and dorms available, or bring your van.

items.title: Token rewards for completed projects
items.text: We offer tokens to builders who take a project from start to completion. Each project lists its reward, and the final terms are agreed with the team before you start.

items.title: Community culture
items.text: Experience co-living with fellow builders and the {{platformName}} team: regular community activities, shared dinners, music jams, yoga and more.

content.title: Skills & qualifications
content.body:
You do not need all of these — most projects need one or two.

- Practical build skills
- Electrical
- Plumbing
- Cement & plastering
- Carpentry
- Painting & decorating
- Stoneworks
- Tools & machinery operation
- Design & drawing skills

content.title: Planning your stay
content.body:
Open a project above to see its dates, scope and reward, then apply from that page — your application is tied to the project you pick.

Please try to book your stay starting from the 1st or the 15th of the month, so you arrive alongside other people and we can onboard you together.

/citizenship.description: Citizenship at {{platformName}}: belonging, governance, and access through tokens.

content.title: Become a Citizen of {{platformName}}
content.body: Join the founding citizens co-creating a regenerative village. Citizenship blends commons-based access, tokenized governance, and hands-on land stewardship.

items.title: Belonging & Community
items.text: Perpetual entry to {{platformName}} spaces, a membership NFT as proof of citizenship, access to the members area, a citizens-only group, and citizen-only programs.

items.title: Governance & Voice
items.text: Submit forum proposals, vote on decisions, participate in community calls, and co-create via tokenized, transparent governance systems.

items.title: Flexible Booking & Stays
items.text: Book up to 1 year in advance, extended stays up to 180 days, shorter minimum stay requirements, and instant booking capabilities.

items.title: Priority Access & Events
items.text: Priority access to events in both participant and creator modes, early co-housing opportunities, and exclusive citizen gatherings.

items.title: Financial Benefits
items.text: Access to financed token plans with flexible payment options, earn stay credits for volunteering work, and reduced fees for citizen activities.

items.title: Make Real Impact
items.text: Bring projects forward, earn recognition via Proof of Presence & Sweat systems, directly regenerate land and community, and shape the future of {{platformName}}.

content.title: Citizen Pathway
content.description: A simple journey from first contact to full participation.

items.title: Cultural Onboarding
items.text: Learn {{platformName}} culture, governance and shared agreements.

items.title: Spend {{citizenshipStayRequirement}} on the land
items.text: Establish your Proof of Presence and meet the community.

items.title: Hold {{citizenshipTokensRequired}} {{tokenName}}
items.text: Buy outright or choose a financed plan (utility unlocked instantly).

items.title: Get vouched
items.text: Fellow members vouch for your alignment and care.

items.title: Sign Citizen Agreement
items.text: Confirm your responsibilities and rights.
Attend ≥1 community call per quarter; join the annual Citizen Gathering.
Presence guideline: visit 2+ weeks per year; keep Proof of Presence active.
Live the culture: care for land, people, and projects; uphold agreements.

content.title: Ready to claim your place as a founding citizen?
content.text: Step into agency, belonging, and impact. Help us complete the village and grow the commons.

items.title: How many tokens do I need for citizenship?
items.text: You need to hold {{citizenshipTokensRequired}} tokens to become a citizen. Financed options let you build towards this over time with instant utility unlocked from day one.

items.title: Do I have to live here full time?
items.text: No. Many citizens spend seasons at {{platformName}} and contribute remotely between visits. Minimum presence guideline is 2+ weeks per year to stay in sync with the culture.

items.title: What if I'm new to land stewardship?
items.text: Great. We have cultural onboarding, hands-on workdays, and an education program so you can learn by doing.

items.title: Can I resell or transfer {{tokenName}}?
items.text: Tokens are locked until the Go-Live event. See the token page for mechanics and current pricing.

items.title: Where can I read the full responsibilities/rights?
items.text: See the community agreements for detailed roles, expectations, rituals, and governance processes.
